reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: M. William Hubler
reviews.text: Once again Michael and his crew have performed a miracle. They have been providing us with excellent service for over 8 years. Helene destroyed our backyard and Michael and his crew restored it. The photos speak for themselves. Thank you Michael. This is the property care company to use.

reviews.author: Denise Starkweather
reviews.text: We cannot thank Michael's tree service enough! Totally impressed with the entire crews attention to safety and details! All were very friendly and respectful of our property. We had a large request and they delivered with excellence. At the end of the day you would never have guessed they were here, the cleanup was outstanding!!! Highly recommend!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Lilla Howerton
reviews.text: Michael answered the phone when I call and came to my property the same day to give me a reasonable quote. His team showed up on scheduled dates and did an outstanding job. The photos below are 1. Afterward 2. . Before

reviews.author: Pamela and Jimmy Poole
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company! Professional, great customer service, quick response. They clean and remove all debris! They even raked our yard.

reviews.author: Lindsay Brown
reviews.text: We had several large trees taken down on our property by Michael’s Tree, and we could not have asked for better results! Great price, great customer service, and they cleaned up so well you couldn’t even tell they had come in the first place! Hardest working group of men! Thanks for great service!

reviews.author: Jim Klopfer
reviews.text: Michael did some work on my property recently. He gave me a very fair quote, scheduled it, showed up 5 minutes early with 3 trucks, a chipper, a machine, and 8 hard working guys. They did the work, cleaned up meticulously, and were friendly. Highly recommend them!!!

reviews.author: Andrea Simpkins
reviews.text: Absolutely the best. Gave us a quote the same day we called. Gave us a fair price. Showed up when he said he would. In at 8. Out at 3:30. He and his crew were very respectful of the property and us. The cleanup was the best Ive ever seen with tree services. Give him a call. Photos are before and after.

reviews.author: Dean Hinkley
reviews.text: Fantastic service and a good price! The owner came out and impressed us with his knowledge, worked with us as to what we wanted done and didn't want done along with making some suggestions of his own, gave us a price, and left. After meeting with a competitor we called back and asked for a date. On the set date the whole crew came out and did an amazing job, cut everything we wanted, cleaned up even more than we expected, all without damaging the buildings or the power line. This included the complete taking down of several trees that were leaning over the house and power line and trimming up several others. They were also very respectful of our property, I had to beg them to take the short cut across a deck instead of around it! We have more trees elsewhere on the property that we'll probably want dealt with, we will definitely call Michael's Tree Service first and only from here on!

reviews.author: Sydneye Trudics
reviews.text: We contacted Michael's to have some very large trees, 120', removed from our property. Miguel came and provided us a very reasonable estimate. He scheduled to come the following week. The team arrived on time and did an amazing job. They worked safely and efficiently. When they were finished the property was left clean! I would highly recommend Michaels Tree Service.

reviews.author: Richard Edfeldt
reviews.text: I contacted Michael about a huge oak tree that was splitting down the middle.He came the same day to see the project and gave me a very reasonable bid which I accepted via a handshake. He was out the next day and the tree was gone within four hours. He had a uniformed crew of @8 working in unison to trim down the tree and using a mulcher for the branches. Very impressive!

reviews.author: John Brown
reviews.text: Amazed at what this crew did today at our property! They were all hardworking and professional. The cleanup was next to none, again simply amazed. Very fair price and awesome job done!

reviews.author: Thomas Hodgson
reviews.text: Michael and his crew are the most honorable and a true blessing to have them here in Franklin. He and his crew showed up today on time. They immediately went to work taking down two large trees. It a pleasure to say that they the best tree company I have ever used over the years. I can’t say enough high marks for him and his crew. If you want the best, call Michael’s. HIGHLY RECOMMEND Tom Hodgson

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.text: I cant begin to say, how pleased I am! I was scheduled for a very large tree next to home and outbuilding to be removed. Also, large problematic Bradford Pear trees, near home and power lines. They came when scheduled, and very fair price. They arrived early, worked until finished- alllll day! Very large crew, nice professional equipment and service, very polite and accommodating. They cleaned up every tiny stick, sawdust… left the yard better than when they arrived. I look forward to using them again soon! I wish I’d done this years ago!

reviews.author: Ben Davis
reviews.text: Michael’s Tree Service provided an excellent experience from start to finish. Their team was punctual, well-organized, and equipped with the tools needed to get the job done right. They handled the tree removal process and clean-up with efficiency and ensured that every aspect of the job was completed to the highest standard.

reviews.author: Elaine Rayborn
reviews.text: We are so pleased with this company and the owner. They came early today and did a wonderful job with trimming some very high limbs over our new roof. They cut down some other trees and made sure everything was cleaned up and that we were satisfied with their work. I highly recommend Michael and his crew. We will be using them again in the future. Price was very reasonable.

reviews.author: Michael Hagan
reviews.text: This is a very professional tree service! They removed two trees and trimmed another. Very reasonable pricing. The entire crew is very friendly and kind. Highly recommend Michael's Tree Service for all of your needs.

reviews.author: Petra Burns
reviews.text: We had a white pine that was massive and dying 20 feet from the house. I called Michael’s and the same day he came and gave me a reasonable estimate and a timely date to remove the tree. Additionally, we needed another tree trimmed and a fallen tree trunk cut up to access the rest of the property. We are out-of-towners so we could not be at the house when the job was done but we did not have to worry about a thing. The crew showed up on time, did amazing work ( we watched on the cameras), cleaned up the yard (has never been so clean) and did all the little extras we needed to do. They even made sure the neighborhood dog was petted and safe the entire time. When the job was done, they sent pictures of the entire process so we could see the final results and texted if all was done to our liking and if anything else was needed. Talk about 5 star quality and service, I’d give them 10 stars if I could. Will use Michael’s Tree service again and again. Highly recommend especially if your Franklin home is a vacation home and you can’t be here when tree work needs to be done.

reviews.author: Deb Rowland
reviews.text: Excellent service! We were so impressed with their professionalism, very reasonable, and quality of work. We highly recommend Michael’s tree service to our neighbors and friends and anyone needing trees removed.

reviews.author: Louis Griffith
reviews.text: Michaels Tree Service went above and beyond our expectations. They arrived when they told us they would and they worked diligently and treated our property with utmost respect. We have already engaged them for another project in November. All 8 of them are fantastic workers.

reviews.author: Ellen Harris
reviews.text: I wish I could give Michael's Tree Services 10 stars. Do not even bother to get an estimate from anyone else. His prices are fair and he did exactly what we agreed on and more. I am rarely happy with any of the tree services in Franklin and we have used all of them. Michael's Tree Service exceeded my expectations. There is no reason to put off getting tree work done because his prices are fair and he comes out with a large crew and gets the job done quickly.

reviews.author: Frank Yongue
reviews.text: The staff at Michael's was excellent. They came out on Saturday, gave me an estimate, and came back on Tuesday to trim my trees. When they finished, they cleaned up the area. Looked like they were never there. I highly recommend them. It is hard this day to find companies and workers that take pride in their work.

reviews.author: Steven Shepherd
reviews.text: I have used Michael's Tree Services several times to fall trees, remove fallen trees, split wood, etc.. Miguel and his crew are always on-time (or communicate if something comes up) and very conscientious to leave my property actually better than they found it (clean-up and blowing debris). I would recommend you get a quote for your job from Michael's Tree Service!

reviews.author: June Tassillo
reviews.text: They come every year to trim our trees. Very professional and they work together like a well oiled machine. Clean up like they were never here.

reviews.author: Harry Hong
reviews.text: They came to trim and remove some trees behind our house. They were on time and very professional. After finishing, they blew all the laves from our paved driveway. Very happy with their service, the owner and crew definitely take pride in their work!

reviews.author: victoria ellison
reviews.text: Very professional company and staff. They started on time and made sure that we were satisfied before they finished up ! Best tree work we have ever had done! Also very reasonably priced for the great service !! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Lora Barham
reviews.text: Called Miguel at 6:00 am today. He called back at 6:15 am. Said he would arrive at 9:00 am. He arrived at 8:50 am (EARLY!!). He did the emergency job in 20 minutes. I cannot recommend this company highly enough!!

reviews.author: Jane Morgan
reviews.text: They were a pleasant group of men. Very professional . Did a fantastic job. Will use them again and recommend them to anyone needing a tree service.

reviews.author: Carolyn McGuire
reviews.text: Great Tree guys, delivered same day and right on time. They placed & stacked the wood perfect. Will be calling them again soon!

reviews.author: Donna Parker
reviews.text: Would highly recommend this company. Only ones out of 3 calls that called and were here in 3 days. Did a good job.
